# FLX-7131: consumer queries need an optional library that is not installed

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

Consumer queries run in DuckDB and read the run's tables as Arrow, so they need duckdb and pyarrow, which the sql extra installs: pip install 'flux-sim-engine[sql]'. Generation reads no SQL, so nothing else in the engine needs either library. Install the extra and run the command again; nothing was counted.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7131
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
